title: SceneSetSummary
description: One scene set as the scene-api lists it: its versions, size and, per enricher and fingerprint, how many of its scenes have a record. A coverage entry is complete when every scene has one; consumers pin the fingerprints they accept and list only sets complete under them.

version.description: Data version of the scene set: hash(asset version + segmentation fingerprint).

created_at.description: UTC timestamp, RFC 3339 with a 'Z' suffix.

enrichments.description: Coverage per (enricher, fingerprint), sorted; every fingerprint with at least one record.

scene_count.description: Scenes of the set with a record under this fingerprint.

fingerprint.description: Step or enricher fingerprint: twelve hex digits.
